requirements.acceptance: Research distinguishes migration experience from first-time adoption.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Validate the catalogue-first journey with self-service, assisted and institutional merchant cohorts.
requirements.acceptance: Activation and first-revenue metrics are reported by onboarding path.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Target at least 1,000 activated Shop businesses in the first commercial year, subject to approved operating capacity.
requirements.acceptance: The metric uses the documented activated-Shop definition.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Target a 50% revenue activation rate among activated Shops.
requirements.acceptance: Revenue activation is defined as at least one recognised revenue event within the approved cohort window.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Target 40% promotion adoption through Ascend Discover.
requirements.acceptance: The denominator and merchant-paid versus sponsored activity are reported separately.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Measure time to first publication-ready product, Shop activation, first qualified visit, first order and first recognised revenue.
requirements.acceptance: Each duration uses a canonical starting event and cohort.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Measure catalogue quality, payment completion, fulfilment completion, cancellation, refund and repeat customer behaviour.
requirements.acceptance: Metrics use auditable order and payment states.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Measure merchant retention by meaningful commerce activity rather than login alone.
requirements.acceptance: Retention reports distinguish active, revenue-active and promotion-active merchants.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Measure support burden, Account Manager effort, messaging cost, payment cost and infrastructure cost per active merchant.
requirements.acceptance: Commercial decisions can use contribution-margin inputs.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Require product, security, payments, evidence and operations sign-off before each major release stage.
requirements.acceptance: Release evidence and unresolved exceptions are documented.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Provide launch rollback and customer communication plans.
requirements.acceptance: A critical defect can be contained without losing accepted orders or payments.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Conduct merchant and customer research after each rollout cohort.
requirements.acceptance: Findings translate into prioritised decisions rather than untracked feedback.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Do not expand into additional countries before Ghana activation, support and unit economics meet approved thresholds.
requirements.acceptance: Country launch approval includes local payments, pricing, legal, language and support readiness.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Publish a post-launch review comparing targets, actuals, learning and next decisions.
requirements.acceptance: Leadership receives an evidence-based commercial and product review.
requirements.section: Rollout and First-Year Commercial Plan Requirements: REL

requirements.requirement: Provide test stores and sandbox payment flows isolated from production evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Test activity cannot affect merchant readiness or production reporting.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Run automated regression tests on every release candidate.
requirements.acceptance: Critical failures block deployment.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Perform a controlled merchant usability test before pilot release.
requirements.acceptance: Observed failures are documented and prioritised.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test interrupted checkout and repeated payment callback scenarios.
requirements.acceptance: No duplicate order, payment, receipt, ledger or evidence record is created.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test image-heavy catalogues on target mobile devices and networks.
requirements.acceptance: Store remains usable within performance budgets.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test buyer flows without an account and with common browser privacy settings.
requirements.acceptance: Core purchase works without third-party cookie dependence.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test catalogue-first onboarding with first-time merchants using real phone cameras and mixed-quality product images.
requirements.acceptance: Observed merchants can publish at least three accurate products without hidden facilitator intervention.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test AI outputs across pilot categories for wrong identity, unsupported claims, brand uncertainty and sensitive content.
requirements.acceptance: Unsafe or low-confidence outputs enter review or manual-entry states and do not auto-publish.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA

requirements.requirement: Test interrupted upload, analysis and activation recovery.
requirements.acceptance: The merchant resumes without duplicate products, repeated charges or lost edits.
requirements.section: Quality Assurance and Release Acceptance Requirements: QA
